1.en_consolidated_definition:
Boriqueño (adj.) 

Portoriccan. "There was a night of centuries —in Borinquen's history—, whose gloom the sorrowful soul remembers." Brau, ; Fallen Leaves, 1909, p.134.

Nota: En este contexto, "Boriquen" se refiere al nombre indígena de la isla de Puerto Rico.
